# Amazon

> > Amazon is the world's largest online retailer offering e-commerce, Prime membership, cloud computing, digital streaming, and grocery delivery through Whole Foods Market.

Amazon.com provides a comprehensive shopping platform with millions of products across categories including books, electronics, home goods, and groceries. The site features Prime membership benefits, payment products like Amazon Visa and Store Cards, seller programs for businesses, and integrated services including Amazon Devices, Amazon Hub, and Whole Foods Market delivery.

## Key Topics

- Amazon Prime
- Whole Foods Market
- Prime membership benefits
- Amazon payment products (Visa, Store Card, Secured Card, Business Card)
- Amazon Devices
- Seller programs and Amazon Business
- Grocery delivery and weekly sales
- Customer service and account management
- Bestsellers and product listings
- Prepared foods and organic groceries
- Amazon Hub
- Prime Video streaming
- Amazon Science
- E-commerce and online shopping

## Core Shopping Experience

- [Amazon.com. Spend less. Smile more.](https://www.amazon.com/): Amazon main homepage featuring luxury brands and e-commerce offerings
- [Amazon.com: Homepage](https://www.amazon.com/stores/Homepage/page/1C97BE5A-7354-49E3-828D-1A49B8513E5E): Main homepage with navigation to Prime, seller programs, and services
- [USA Store](https://www.amazon.com/stores/USA/node/17376892011): USA store featuring bestsellers and consumer products
- [Amazon.com: Home](https://www.amazon.com/stores/Home/page/C11117E2-47BF-49F6-A82F-5668EB971777): Home furnishings and essentials with Amazon payment product info
- [Books Category](https://www.amazon.com/s?rh=n:2235625011): Books category search results and bestseller listings

## Account & Membership

- [Your Account](https://www.amazon.com/gp/css/homepage.html): Amazon account management hub for orders, payments, and Prime settings
- [Amazon.com: Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.com/amazonprime): Amazon Prime membership page with benefits, pricing, and Prime Video

## Grocery & Food Services

- [Whole Foods Market: Shop Groceries & Weekly Sales](https://wfm.amazon.com/): Whole Foods Market grocery store with Prime delivery and weekly sales
